rows.note: Use 阿嫂 as the all-purpose everyday term for a brother's wife, especially an older brother's wife.

example.english: My sister-in-law cooks really well, and the whole family loves her food.
example.traditional: 我阿嫂煮飯好好食，成家人都鍾意食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 sou2 zyu2 faan6 hou2 hou2 sik6 sing4 gaa1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 sik6

rows.note: Use 姨仔 for your wife's sister, especially when referring to her as a family relation rather than specifying her age.

example.english: My sister-in-law often asks my wife to go shopping.
example.traditional: 我個姨仔成日約我老婆去行街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 ji1 zai2 seng4 jat6 joek3 ngo5 lou5 po4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1

rows.note: Use 姑奶 for your husband's sister; it is the counterpart to 姨仔 on the wife's side.

example.english: My sister-in-law comes back for dinner every festive season.
example.traditional: 我個姑奶逢年過節都會返嚟食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gu1 naai1 fung4 nin4 gwo3 zit3 dou1 wui6 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6
